item.title: Clendon Thomas, a Hall of Fame running back for Oklahoma in the 1950s, dies at 90
item.description: Clendon Thomas, a Hall of Fame running back who helped Oklahoma win two national titles in the 1950s, has died. He was 90. Chuck Bowman, Thomas’ longtime friend and former college roommate, said Tuesday that Thomas died of pneumonia on Monday night in Tulsa.
